curator_evidence: Wan et al. 2024 define a 598-child paper cohort comprising 264 ASD and 334 TD participants and explicitly include microbial DNA from their previous study. dataset_title: Gut and Oral Microbiome Signatures in ASD Sibling Pairs and Their Impact on BBB Integrity
notes: Public ENA/SRA metadata for SRP681807 expose 16 runs and 16 BioSamples corresponding to 8 unique human participants sampled at two body sites each. Sample aliases ASDF*/ASDO* and CTRF*/CTRO* indicate four ASD participants and four discordant sibling controls, with F = faeces/gut and O = oral swab. ENA read_run metadata confirm 16S V3-V4 amplicon sequencing on Illumina MiSeq with paired-end layout for all 16 runs. ENA BioSample XML records directly confirm Homo sapiens host, Italy as geographic location, faeces for the F-series samples, and oral swab/oral cavity for the O-series samples. study_design was normalized as case_control because the repository study title and sample structure explicitly describe discordant ASD sibling pairs versus control sibling records. Because this accession intentionally combines faecal and oral samples under one human ASD/control study rather than a single anatomical site, body_site_normalized was harmonized to other to preserve a single-value controlled vocabulary while keeping the literal mixed-site description in body_site_raw/sample_type_raw. No linked publication, DOI, or PMID was visible on the public ENA/SRA pages used here, and the linked BioProject PRJNA1433220 carries the same title without PubMed linkage, so this row is treated as a repository-only mixed-site human microbiome study rather than a paper-verified publication row. | Count eight participants once and change body site from other to gut;oral.
curator_evidence: SRP681807 resolves to primary BioProject PRJNA1433220. ENA exposes 16 paired MiSeq records: fecal and oral samples from four ASD and four control participants, identifiable through ASDF/ASDO and CTRF/CTRO aliases.
